stem: A 5-year-old is brought to an Australian GP clinic after putting a dried bean into the external ear canal; which feature makes this object the strongest reason for urgent removal?

options.text: It may cause diffuse otitis externa
It should be soothed with warm oil
It means hearing loss must already be present

explanation: It may expand with moisture. This is because organic foreign bodies such as a dried bean can swell when exposed to moisture, increasing impaction and making urgent removal important.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because organic foreign bodies such as a dried bean can swell when exposed to moisture, increasing impaction and making urgent removal important.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because diffuse otitis externa is an ear canal infection, not the key feature that makes a bean urgent to remove.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because warm oil is used for some live insects, not for a dried bean in the ear canal.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the presence of a foreign body does not by itself indicate tympanic membrane perforation.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because hearing loss may occur, but it is not required for an urgent foreign body presentation.
